product_overview: Baan Ai Oun Property is a bilingual Thai/English real estate marketing website for browsing properties and generating sales leads. Visitors can search listings, view property details, and submit multiple types of inquiry forms that connect to the sales team.
core_goals: Browse and filter property listings to find relevant homes, condos, and land
View detailed property information, images, and mortgage estimates
Submit service requests and contact inquiries for buying, selling, renting, and co-agent recruitment
Access company information, services, blog content, and contact channels in both Thai and English

features.name: Tabbed Service Request Form
features.description: A primary lead-generation page with three service tabs for property listing, property matchmaking, and co-agent requests. Each tab presents a 7-field form with adapted labels and submits a service request with optional image uploads.
user_flows: Navigate to /request -> Select the property listing tab -> Enter name, contact details, property type, location, and optional budget -> Optionally upload images -> Submit the form -> See a bilingual success confirmation

Navigate to /request -> Select the property matchmaking tab -> Enter name, contact details, desired property type, location, and optional budget -> Optionally upload images -> Submit the form -> See a bilingual success confirmation

Navigate to /request -> Select the co-agent tab -> Enter name, contact details, property type, location, and optional budget -> Optionally upload images -> Submit the form -> See a bilingual success confirmation
Navigate to /request -> Leave the email field incomplete or malformed -> Attempt to submit the form -> See a bilingual validation error

features.name: Homepage Hero and Service Shortcuts
features.description: The home page highlights the main services and provides quick navigation from the hero section and service cards into the request and course flows.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the hero action for property listing -> Arrive at the property listing request tab on /request
Navigate to / -> Click the hero action for property matchmaking -> Arrive at the matchmaking request tab on /request
Navigate to / -> Click a service shortcut for listing, matchmaking, or co-agent support -> Arrive at the corresponding /request tab
Navigate to / -> Click the service shortcut for agent training -> Arrive at /agent-course

features.name: Smart Property Search and Listing Filter
features.description: A client-side property search experience that lets visitors narrow preloaded listings by purpose, district, and price on the home page and the full listings page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a purpose filter -> Select a district -> Select a maximum price -> See the property grid narrow to matching listings
Navigate to /properties -> Choose a purpose filter -> Select a district -> Select a maximum price -> See the listing grid narrow to matching properties
Navigate to / -> Select a property card -> Open the matching property detail page
Navigate to /properties -> Select a property card -> Open the matching property detail page

features.name: Property Detail View
features.description: A detailed property page with an image gallery, lightbox navigation, mortgage calculator, and direct contact actions.
user_flows: Navigate to a property detail page -> Open the image gallery -> Browse through property images -> Close the gallery
Navigate to a property detail page -> Change the mortgage calculator inputs -> See the loan chart and estimate update immediately
Navigate to a property detail page -> Choose a direct contact action -> Start a LINE chat or phone call

features.name: Legacy Lead Forms
features.description: Click-to-reveal inquiry forms on the buyer, owner, co-agent, and training pages. The form appears only after the user activates the prompt at the bottom of the page.
user_flows: Navigate to /find-property -> Scroll to the start section for interested visitors -> Reveal the inquiry form -> Fill in the required fields and preferences -> Submit the form -> See a confirmation state

Navigate to /list-property -> Scroll to the start section for property owners -> Reveal the inquiry form -> Fill in the required fields and upload valid images -> Submit the form -> See a confirmation state
Navigate to /co-agent -> Scroll to the start section for potential partners -> Reveal the inquiry form -> Fill in the required partner details -> Submit the form -> See a confirmation state
Navigate to /agent-course -> Scroll to the start section for course applicants -> Reveal the inquiry form -> Fill in the application details -> Submit the form -> See a confirmation state

features.name: Contact Page
features.description: A general contact page with a message form, direct communication links, and an embedded map for reaching the business through multiple channels.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name, phone, email, subject, and message -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /contact -> Choose a direct call, LINE, WhatsApp, or email option -> Open the corresponding contact channel
Navigate to /contact -> Review the embedded map -> Use it to locate the business

features.name: Services Hub Navigation
features.description: A static services page that routes visitors to the main lead-generation and training destinations.
user_flows: Navigate to /services -> Select Find Property -> Open /find-property
Navigate to /services -> Select List Property -> Open /list-property
Navigate to /services -> Select Co-Agent -> Open /co-agent
Navigate to /services -> Select Agent Course -> Open /agent-course

features.name: Blog Listing and Article Reading
features.description: A blog section where visitors can browse articles by category, search posts, and open individual posts with related property suggestions.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog -> Select a category -> See only matching posts
Navigate to /blog -> Enter a search term -> See the article list filter in real time
Navigate to /blog -> Open a blog post -> Read the article and view related property cards
Navigate to a blog post -> Select a related property -> Open the matching property detail page

features.name: Company Information Pages
features.description: Static informational pages that present the company story, milestones, values, and privacy policy in bilingual form.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Review the company story, timeline, and values -> Learn about the business
Navigate to /privacy-policy -> Review the bilingual privacy policy -> Read the site’s personal data policy

routes.description: Home page with hero (2 CTAs to /request), smart property search, service cards, why-choose-us, testimonials, FAQ. Always displays Thai+English together (no language toggle).
NEW tabbed service-request page. 3 tabs (?tab=list-property | matchmaking | co-agent), each with the same 7-field form (adapted labels).
Full property listing grid with purpose/district/price filters
Single property detail page with gallery, mortgage calculator, contact CTAs
Lead-generation landing page for buyers/renters (legacy click-to-reveal form)
Lead-generation landing page for property owners (legacy click-to-reveal form, image upload, FAQ)
Partner/co-agent recruitment landing page (legacy click-to-reveal form)
Services hub linking to Find Property, List Property, Co-Agent, Agent Course
Marketing page for agent training course with application form
Blog listing with category filter and search (may have no published posts)
Single blog post page with related properties
Contact page with inline form, click-to-call/LINE/WhatsApp links, embedded map
Company story, milestones/timeline, and values (static content)
Bilingual PDPA privacy policy (static content), linked from footer

features.name: Service Request Tabbed Form (NEW - primary test target)
features.description: One page with 3 selectable service tabs; each tab shows a form with 7 fields (labels adapt per tab). Submissions insert into a per-tab Supabase table and fire LINE/email notifications.
user_interactions: Click one of 3 tab cards (ฝากขาย/ปล่อยเช่า | จัดหาทรัพย์ตามต้องการ | ร่วมเป็น Co-Agent) — URL ?tab= updates
Fill name (required), phone/WhatsApp/LINE (required), email (required, format-validated)
Select property type from dropdown (บ้านเดี่ยว, บ้านแฝด, ทาวน์โฮม, คอนโด, ที่ดิน) (required)
Fill location (required), budget (optional)
Optionally upload up to 5 images (jpg/png/webp, 5MB each)
Submit; see bilingual success card; "Submit Another Request" resets
Submitting with missing/invalid email shows bilingual validation error

features.name: Homepage Hero & Service CTAs (redesigned)
features.description: Hero has 2 CTA buttons linking to /request tabs; 4 service cards below, first 3 link to /request tabs, 4th to /agent-course. CTA labels are stacked Thai-over-English.
user_interactions: Click hero "ฝากขาย/ปล่อยเช่า | List Your Property" → /request?tab=list-property
Click hero "บริการจัดหาทรัพย์ตามต้องการ | Property Matchmaking Service" → /request?tab=matchmaking
Click service card CTAs → /request tabs or /agent-course

features.name: Smart Property Search & Filter
features.description: Client-side filtering of preloaded property listings by purpose, district, and price on home and listing pages
user_interactions: Click purpose tab (All / Buy / Rent / Land)
Select district and max price from dropdowns
Click a property card (aria-label = property title) to open /property/[slug]

features.name: Property Detail View
features.description: Single property page with image gallery lightbox and live mortgage/loan calculator
user_interactions: Open image gallery lightbox and navigate images
Use mortgage calculator inputs; chart updates live
Click LINE or phone CTA

features.name: Legacy Lead Forms (click-to-reveal)
features.description: On /find-property, /list-property, /co-agent, /agent-course the form only appears AFTER clicking the "Ready to Get Started?" primary CTA button at the page bottom. Do not report "form not found" without clicking that CTA first.
user_interactions: Scroll to bottom CTA section, click primary button to reveal the form
Fill and submit (POST /api/submit-form, rate limit 3/min/IP)

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: General contact form with subject selection, plus direct contact links and embedded map
user_interactions: Fill name/phone/email, select subject, fill message, submit
Click call / LINE / WhatsApp / email cards

features.name: Bilingual Display (no toggle)
features.description: Site permanently displays Thai and English together (Thai primary, English secondary). There is NO language switcher.
user_interactions: Verify both languages visible simultaneously on any page

known_limitations.issue: Testing against PRODUCTION deployment via local proxy
known_limitations.impact: Form submissions create REAL rows in the production database and fire REAL LINE/email notifications to the site owner. Submit at most ONE test per form, and always prefix test names with "TestSprite" so the owner can identify and delete them.
/buy /rent /land → /find-property, /owners → /list-property, /academy → /agent-course (301). These are redirects only; do not treat as pages.
Do not submit forms rapidly; space out submissions.

known_limitations.issue: Blog may have no published posts
known_limitations.impact: An empty blog listing with "ยังไม่มีบทความ" is expected behavior, not a bug.
